provenance.edges: measured (filtered to strongest by synapse count)

layout.method: force-directed SGD with negative sampling (LargeVis family)
layout.separationNote: Mean distance between connected neurons divided by mean distance between random neurons. Below 1 means the layout encodes real connectivity; ~1 would mean it encodes nothing.
layout.warning: Coordinates encode connectivity proximity, not anatomical position. The repository ships no soma coordinates.
